comments.body: PR #482 merged. Tested at 768px and 1024px breakpoints in Chrome and Safari - cards no longer overlap. Moving to Done.
Pulled the dashboard on a tablet during break - cards holding their grid now at 768px. Signing off as charge nurse - safe to close for the ER floor.
Still seeing long drug names cut off (Hydroxyzine Pamoate Metoprolol Succinate). Need tooltip on hover or a min column width.
Picked this up. Will land tooltip on hover + ellipsis pattern next sprint.
PR #514 merged 2026-05-06. Password error now wraps above the submit button on iOS Safari and Android Chrome at 360px.
Looks good in QA staging on my end. Moving to Done.
Confirmed on Android Chrome too. Closing.
Marking Wont Fix - design team says zebra striping is on the v2 roadmap not this sprint.
Reproduced on night shift - timestamps unreadable on the Recent Activity card under low-light ER lighting. Tagging Critical.
Token swap landing in next theme refresh. Tracking for sprint 5.
EHR vendor confirms the indication field is in the v3 payload. Waiting on integration ticket BKD-118 before we can wire it through.
Started prototyping the token-bucket implementation. Initial benchmarks suggest 10ms p99 overhead per request, which is within budget.
Confirmed the deprecated widgets are no longer referenced in the dashboard repo. Safe to remove.

issues.description: Dashboard stats cards overlap each other on tablet viewports under 768px. Reported by Patty during the Apr review walkthrough.
issues.title: Stats cards overlap on tablet viewport below 768px

issues.description: Medications form drug name column truncates without a tooltip on hover. Long drug names (Hydroxyzine Pamoate, Metoprolol Succinate) are unreadable.
issues.title: Drug name column truncates at 15 characters without tooltip

issues.description: Create Account form password validation error overlaps the submit button on iOS Safari and Android Chrome at sub-400px widths.
issues.title: Password field validation error message overlaps submit button on mobile

issues.description: Symptoms Reported table on the dashboard has no zebra striping. Hard to track which row you are reading. Design says wont fix until v2.
issues.title: Symptoms Reported table has no alternating row colors hard to scan

issues.description: Add Medication form Dosage input shows placeholder text "e.g. 200mg" but no persistent visible label. Violates portal spec rule that requires visible labels for clinical inputs.
issues.title: Add Medication form Dosage field has no label only placeholder text

issues.description: Dark mode renders Recent Activity timestamps as white text on a near-white card. Completely unreadable in low-light ER lighting.
issues.title: Dark mode Recent Activity timestamps invisible white text on light gray

issues.description: Reason For Taking column on the Medications table is blank for every patient. EHR integration is not piping the indication field through.
issues.title: Reason For Taking column is always empty no data flowing from EHR integration

issues.description: Create Account form email field fires the invalid-email error after the second keystroke. Should debounce or wait for blur.
issues.title: Create Account form email validation fires before user finishes typing distracting

issues.description: Implement per-user rate limiting on /v1/* using a token-bucket algorithm in Redis. Need X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset headers on all responses. Initial benchmarks suggest 10ms p99 overhead per request, which is within budget.
issues.title: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints

issues.description: Profile edits should invalidate downstream cached views in the dashboard service. Today the dashboard can show stale display names for up to 30 minutes after a profile update.
issues.title: Cache invalidation cascade on user profile updates

issues.description: Bulk export occasionally times out at 30s under high load. Need to add streaming responses and tune connection keep-alive on the upstream proxy.
issues.title: Investigate intermittent 504 on bulk export endpoint

issues.description: Generate complete OpenAPI 3.1 schema from the FastAPI app and publish it to the docs site.
issues.title: Add OpenAPI 3.1 schema export for v2 endpoints

issues.description: Remove deprecated metrics widgets superseded by the new dashboard project. Confirmed the deprecated widgets are no longer referenced in the dashboard repo.
issues.title: Old metrics dashboard cleanup
